description.zh: 订阅ID。您可通过[CreateEventSub](~~2848209~~)接口的返回参数查询订阅ID。
description.en: The subscription ID. You can obtain the ID from the response to the [CreateEventSub](~~2848209~~) operation.

title.zh: 删除订阅房间消息回调

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[CreateEventSub](~~2848209~~)创建订阅房间消息的回调。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, make sure that you have called the [CreateEventSubscribe](~~2848209~~) operation to create a callback that is used to subscribe to channel or user events.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.
